SELECT e.id as eventId, e.title, e.age_limit, e.description, e.genre, e.thumbnail_url, es.id as eventScheduleId, es.ticket_open_at, es.event_date, v.venue_name, e.account_id as tenant_id FROM tb_event e JOIN tb_event_schedule es ON es.event_id = e.id JOIN tb_venue v ON es.venue_id = v.id
WHERE e.id = #{event_id}
SELECT class_name, price FROM tb_price p JOIN tb_seat_class sc ON p.seat_class_id = sc.id WHERE event_schedule_id = #{eventScheduleId};

SELECT #{eventScheduleId} as event_schedule_id, #{seatId} as seat_id, e.id as "event.event_id", e.title as "event.event_title", DATE_FORMAT(es.ticket_open_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as "event_schedule.ticket_open_at", DATE_FORMAT(es.event_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as "event_schedule.event_date", s.floor as "seat.floor", s.row as "seat.row", s.col as "seat.col", sc.id as "seat.seat_class.seat_class_id", sc.class_name as "seat.seat_class.class_name" FROM tb_seat s JOIN tb_seat_class sc ON s.seat_class_id = sc.id JOIN tb_venue v ON s.venue_id = v.id JOIN tb_event_schedule es ON es.venue_id = v.id JOIN tb_event e ON es.event_id = e.id WHERE es.id = #{eventScheduleId} AND s.id = #{seatId}
